name: Bar Chart Race
summary: A broadcast-style ranking race where Acme Pulse enters at #1 and Checkout conversion plunges down the board.
look: Off-white broadcast board with rounded grey bars, one teal hero bar and a coral faller. A giant ghosted clock or count sits bottom-right; mono values ride the bar tips.

components.name: Race bar
components.role: rounded rank bar with label inside and mono value at the tip

components.name: Ghost clock
components.role: huge faint timestamp or count that anchors time

components.name: Rank-change chip
components.role: ▲/▼ mono tag showing places gained or lost

components.name: Speed lines
components.role: three trailing strokes that sell velocity on entry

components.name: Drop trail
components.role: dashed curve showing where a bar fell from

components.name: Callout card
components.role: white card with coral rule for the anomaly numbers

motion.name: Rank swap
motion.how: bars trade y-positions with power2.inOut 0.5 s, exactly one beat at 120 BPM, width tweens linearly

motion.name: New-entry slam
motion.how: entry bar x from −100 % to 0 with expo.out 0.4 s on the drop, others ease down 0.25 s later

motion.name: Clock tick
motion.how: ghost clock digits step every 0.25 s (8th notes), freeze with a 2-frame scale 1.04 on the anomaly

story: Hook: 38 dashboards race for attention while the count ticks up. Drop: a teal Acme Pulse bar slams in at #1. Proof: metric-health race, Checkout conversion falls #1 → #5 in coral at 09:42 after deploy #2231, a callout and Roll back. CTA: one teal bar, Resolved in 6 min, Start free.
adapt: Race whatever your product ranks: top endpoints, busiest queues, most-used features. Let your product enter as the bar that sees everything, and show the anomaly as a rank collapse.

references.note: bar chart race template: rank swaps, timed captions, counter
why races and time sliders work for data stories
D3 reference implementation of keyframed rank interpolation

fit.risk: Races are addictive but noisy; if more than ~6 bars move at once nobody can follow the one that matters.
